pages.note: a page about running a findings tester script, not about what GuardDuty covers

Every statement on this page sits under a bold subject naming what it is about: a protection plan, an API, or one finding type. Reading the sentences without that subject put all of them on a catch-all 'GuardDuty findings' row, which then read '2 excluded of 46' — a claim about GuardDuty findings as a whole that the page never makes. Only the protection-plan exclusions are feature-level coverage. A finding type missing from one Region is a fact about that one catalogue member, and we count catalogues rather than measuring them, so those are not published.
